context: Revision 1 was sub-mv1eqk2q-01cc29a2. The phase split, criterion claims, live checks and the lesson decision are unchanged. The changes are listed in .eccode/artifacts/plan/revision-2-notes.md. One fact goes beyond the review's recommendation: on Node 22.22, node --test ignores a missing explicit file whenever any other pattern or file in the same command matches. Appending files (`npm test -- <file>`, `npm run test:browser -- <file>`) or listing a new file next to an old one would therefore still pre-pass (ev:ev-mv1f3hiv-01a9ae95). That is why every command now starts with an `ls` existence guard over files that only that task creates.
